summary: Iteration 2 testing: Options trading feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed (8 new options tests + 10 regression tests from iteration 1). All option strategies (7), suggest for NIFTY/SENSEX/BANKNIFTY with correct lot sizes (75/20/35), payoff calculator with greeks/breakevens/POP, and chain endpoint all working. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): 6-tab bottom bar renders correctly (Market/Signals/Options/Watchlist/Portfolio/History). Options tab loads NIFTY by default, NIFTY/SENSEX/BANKNIFTY chips switch entire view, index snapshot card (spot/ATM/RSI/Lot Size/Trend badge), Recommended Strategy (Iron Condor was suggested in HOLD/sideways regime), Trade Setup with 4 legs (BUY/SELL badge + strike + CALL/PUT + premium + qty), Payoff at Expiry SVG chart with spot line, breakeven lines, Max Profit ₹8,101.5, Max Loss ₹-6,898.5, P(Profit) 48.6%, Breakevens, full Greeks grid (Δ Γ Θ V with hints), and Net Credit/Debit line all rendered. Lot sizes confirmed in UI: NIFTY=75, SENSEX=20, BANKNIFTY=35.

react_native_issues.issue: tabBarTestID prop does NOT propagate to web DOM as data-testid. None of the tab-* testIDs are queryable via [data-testid] selectors on web (tabs visible/clickable by label only). Tested at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx lines 26-73. Non-blocking for users but breaks automated testing of tab navigation by testID.

action_items: (Optional) Tab testID limitation on web: consider wrapping tabs with a custom tabBar or accept that web E2E for tab nav must use text labels. Mobile native builds expose testID correctly so this is web-only.
No functional bugs detected — feature is production-ready for paper/sim use.
critical_code_review_comments: options.py is clean and focused (~290 lines). Black-Scholes math, strategy templates, payoff/POP calculator, and best-effort NSE chain are all well isolated.
POP via Monte Carlo (2000 samples, seeded RNG) is reasonable; deterministic across calls due to seed=42.
fetch_option_chain gracefully returns {available: false, reason: ...} when nsepython is blocked — matches expected behaviour.
options.tsx (~270 lines) is at upper end but still single-screen, readable; PayoffChart split out into its own component. Good.
seed_data_creation: None; uses live yfinance + Black-Scholes calc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run all tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend tab navigation on web must use page.get_by_text('Options').click() because tabBarTestID is NOT exposed as data-testid by expo-router on web. All content-area testIDs (chip-NIFTY/SENSEX/BANKNIFTY, index-snapshot, strategy-card, leg-{i}, payoff-card, greeks-grid) DO work correctly.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Tab testID web-export quirk is a known expo-router web limitation, not a feature defect.
